message: docopt has to be built from source (its index has only a source distribution), but no-build in pyproject.toml forbids building, so installing it fails until it is allowed
fix: Review docopt and add "pypi:docopt" to installScripts.allow in depcurfew.json (it is then always built from source), or replace the package
